entry.title: New: Bill 218 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — FC: Withdrawn - 11/19/2024
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 19, ARTICLE 1, SECTION 19-2, OF THE HAWAIʻI COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO REAL PROPERTY TAXES

Amends the definition of “Affordable rental rate” to mean a monthly rent not to exceed the most recent affordable rental guideline for 100 percent of the area median income as established by the Hawaiʻi housing finance and development corporation.

Latest action: FC: Withdrawn - 11/19/2024
